items.headline: Anthropic warns it's close to recursive self-improvement capability
items.summary: In an amended S-1 filing ahead of its planned IPO, Anthropic disclosed it may soon meet its own Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for AI that dramatically accelerates its own development (RSI), while stressing no current model has crossed that line. The disclosure is notable because it comes from a company actively seeking public investors, highlighting the tension between safety warnings and commercial momentum.

items.headline: AI-linked stocks lose roughly $930 billion in broad November 5 selloff
items.summary: A sharp one-day drop across a dozen major AI-linked stocks, led by Nvidia, Tesla and TSMC, erased close to a trillion dollars in market value as investors weighed chip-demand concerns alongside growing political backlash against data centers.

items.headline: AI and chip stocks slide further as midterm results compound data-center worries
items.summary: Shares across the AI supply chain fell again after Democrats' midterm gains, adding political risk to an AI trade already strained by high interest rates and questions about returns on massive data-center capital spending.

items.headline: US midterm backlash against AI data centers reaches the ballot box
items.summary: Candidates who campaigned against local data-center buildouts won key races in the US midterms, as rising electricity costs and land-use fights turned AI infrastructure into a bipartisan political liability, suggesting growing local resistance could slow the AI boom's buildout.

items.headline: Moonshot AI prepares to open-source weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary: Chinese AI lab Moonshot released its Kimi K3.1 Pro model via API with a 1-million-token context window and said it would publish the full open weights by November 4, continuing the rapid cadence of high-capability open-weight releases from Chinese labs.

items.headline: Anthropic files to go public, targeting a blockbuster Nasdaq IPO
items.summary: Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 with the SEC to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker 'ANT,' reporting roughly $16 billion in first-half 2026 revenue. Reports indicate the company plans to begin marketing the offering as soon as mid-November, in a deal that could rival or exceed OpenAI's own path to public markets.

items.headline: AI infrastructure startup fal raises $1.3B, doubling its valuation to $16B
items.summary: GPU-cloud and generative-media infrastructure company fal closed a new funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with Nvidia joining as a strategic investor, underscoring continued investor appetite for the 'picks and shovels' layer of the AI boom even as public AI stocks wobble.

items.headline: Google to cut off Search access for schools that keep AI tools disabled
items.summary: Google told K-12 school administrators that if they opt out of Gemini and related AI features for student accounts, those students will also lose access to Google Search, a move critics including former FTC chair Lina Khan called an abuse of search dominance to force AI adoption in classrooms.

items.headline: Hugging Face releases new open-weight OCR and 3D-motion models
items.summary: Hugging Face published two new open multimodal models runnable on consumer GPUs: PP-OCRv6, an OCR model covering roughly 50 languages, and MolmoMotion, a language-guided 3D motion-forecasting model, adding to the steady stream of accessible open-weight tooling for developers.

items.headline: Reflection AI releases 'Beam,' a 1M-token open-weight model
items.summary: Reflection AI open-sourced Beam, a large mixture-of-experts model with a one-million-token context window released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license, adding to a steady stream of high-capability open-weight releases that give developers alternatives to closed frontier models.
